oneLine: Lenskart equity worth ₹2,468 crore changes hands in block deals.

sources.title: Lenskart shares decline after 2.07% equity worth ₹2,468 crore changes hands in block deals

synopsis: As many as 3.6 crore shares, representing 2.07% equity of Lenskart Solutions, worth ₹2,468 crore changed hands via block deals on Monday, September 21. The official buyers and sellers are not yet known, though sources previously indicated that Platinum Jasmine A 2018 Trust, an investment vehicle of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, was likely to sell up to 1.7% equity. The transaction was executed at ₹688 per share. The seller in the block deal will be subject to a 90-day lock-up period on further stake sales. This follows previous block deals involving Softbank Vision Fund II Lightbulb and Alpha Wave Ventures over the past month.
